deadline.value: Applications received before February 1 get full consideration for Fall admission; later ones may not be considered if the class is full.
deadline.quote: For Fall admits, applications received before February 1st will be given full consideration

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE.
gre_general.quote: We do not require the GRE.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require the GRE, so no subject test is needed.

fee_waiver.value: The department says it cannot currently offer an application fee waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: No. We cannot currently offer a fee waiver.

supervisor.value: The fetched pages do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Assistantships include a stipend and tuition, but are competitive and not guaranteed to all admitted students; once awarded, funding is guaranteed for five years.
funding.quote: Competition for assistantships is vigorous, and there is no guarantee that all admitted students will receive financial assistance

also.quote: Once an assistantship has been awarded, funding is guaranteed for five years so long as you are making satisfactory progress towards your degree

entry_route.value: The department requires a satisfactory record of undergraduate coursework in chemistry; no master's is listed.
entry_route.quote: Satisfactory record of undergraduate coursework in chemistry

notes: Priority deadline is February 1 for Fall; the Spring priority deadline is July 1.
name: Chemistry (PhD)
